policies.evidence_rule: A licence is recorded only where its actual text establishes it. Uploader declarations, model-card marketing copy and recollection of a related release are not evidence.
policies.fail_closed_rule: A generator enters the dataset only if the act of generation for private non-commercial academic research is established by the licence text AND its output-handling constraints are recorded.
policies.no_cross_release_inference: A licence is never inferred from a different revision, release or model family.
policies.no_inheritance_rule: A model's weight licence is not inherited by, and does not licence, its outputs. Generated text is recorded as outputs_licensed=false.
policies.redistribution_rule: The E2-C1 generated corpus is private. No generated text is redistributed or published verbatim.

prompt_source.name: Wikipedia
prompt_source.notes: Prompt text and generated output are distinct licensing layers. The prompt is CC BY-SA 4.0; the generated output is not licensed by the prompt licence or the weight licence.
prompt_source.share_alike_applies_to: adaptations of the prompt text; the E2-C1 dataset is private and not distributed

scope: E2-C1 self-generated API corpus (three provider runs); provider terms were not independently audited.

notebook_must_assert: every generator_id referenced by the generation config resolves to a model entry
every resolved entry has a status in allowed_statuses
every model entry has a non-empty revision of at least 40 hex characters
no model entry is described as Apache-2.0 unless licence.spdx is Apache-2.0

withdrawn_models.access_requirements: Gated, manual approval. Requires an authenticated Hugging Face account that has accepted the Llama 3.2 terms. The generation job must fail closed without it.
attribution_requirements: 1.b.i: if distributing Llama Materials or a product/service containing them, provide a copy of the Agreement and prominently display 'Built with Llama'.
1.b.i: if Llama Materials or their outputs/results are used to create, train, fine-tune or otherwise improve an AI model that is distributed or made available, the model name must begin with 'Llama'.
1.b.iii: retain the Meta attribution notice in distributed copies of the Llama Materials.
conditions: Requires authenticated access with accepted Llama 3.2 terms; fail closed otherwise.
Generated text must never be redistributed or published verbatim.
Any detector trained on these outputs must begin with 'Llama' in its model name if it is ever distributed or made available.
Licence is bound to revision 0cb88a4f; a revision change requires re-audit.
